C0712.title: Woman Penalized for Using AI to Mass-Produce Clickbait Content
C0712.summary: A woman used AI tools to mass-produce sensational content and widely disseminated it through online communities and self-media platforms for illicit profit. She believed AI-generated information was real and would not be subject to enforcement, but was ultimately given an administrative penalty by the police.

references.title: Woman Uses AI to Mass-Produce Clickbait Articles for Publication and Dissemination, Receives Administrative Penalty
